page.definition_block: Roofers install and repair building roofs, including substrate preparation and the installation of waterproof membranes, asphalt shingles, metal panels, tiles, and other materials. They build functional layers for leak prevention, drainage, and roof insulation and are essential to building-envelope safety.

rows.label: Work Environment
rows.value: Mainly rooftop work at height, heavily affected by weather, cold in winter and hot in summer

rows.label: Education Requirement
rows.value: No strict educational requirement; apprenticeships provide entry and working-at-height credentials are advantageous

rows.label: Key Skills
rows.value: Shingle installation and waterproofing, tool use, safety at height, blueprint reading, physical strength

rows.label: Core Activities
rows.value: Remove, install, fasten, treat flashing, protect safety, clean

rows.label: Work Values
rows.value: Hardworking, safety-conscious, quality-focused

rows.label: Entry Requirement
rows.value: Low: helpers can enter immediately; independent contracting takes two or three years

responsibilities_block: Remove old roofing materials, then inspect and repair the substrate structure and flashing.
Install and fasten waterproof membranes, shingles, metal panels, and other roofing materials.
Waterproof roof joints, flashing, eaves, skylights, and other details.
Install and maintain lifelines, scaffolding, and other fall-protection systems.
Control slope, overlaps, and edge-finishing quality according to drawings and procedures.
Clean the worksite, move materials, and perform post-work inspections.
page.work_context_block: The day's rhythm is to look down while laying materials, look up to measure, and keep the lifeline secured. Check the weather first, because poor conditions stop work. A torch sends waves of heat while applying waterproof membrane, shingles must be aligned and nailed one by one, and edge finishing is the most painstaking stage. One poorly made flashing detail can ruin everything that follows.

page.definition_block: 屋面工（Roofers）负责建筑物屋面的铺设与维修，包括防水卷材、沥青瓦、金属板、瓦片等材料的安装与基层处理，承担防漏、排水与屋面保温等功能层的施工，是保障建筑围护系统安全的关键工种。

responsibilities_block: 拆除旧屋面材料，检查并修补基层结构与泛水。
铺设防水卷材、瓦片、金属板等屋面材料并固定。
处理屋面接缝、泛水、檐口与天窗等防水节点。
安装与维护安全绳、脚手架等高处作业防护设施。
按图纸与工艺要求控制坡度、搭接与收边质量。
清理作业现场，进行材料搬运与工后检查。
page.work_context_block: 一天的主旋律是「低头铺、抬头量、随时绑安全绳」：先看天，天气不好就得停工；铺防水卷材时热熔枪烤得热浪扑面，铺瓦时一片片对齐钉牢，收边是最磨人的环节，一道泛水没做好，后面全白干。

page.definition_block: Tutors teach students one-on-one or in small groups in subjects where they are struggling, diagnose the causes of mistakes, design practice, and track progress to help students meet examination and learning goals.

rows.label: Work Environment
rows.value: Mostly a mix of office and on-site work, varying by role.

rows.label: Entry Requirement
rows.value: A relevant bachelor's degree is the mainstream entry route

rows.label: Core Output
rows.value: Professional tutoring outcomes and decisions.

rows.label: Skill Requirements
rows.value: Strong tutoring expertise + tool use.

rows.label: Working Relationships
rows.value: Reporting upward, coordinating across teams, communicating externally.

rows.label: Scope of Responsibility
rows.value: Professional judgment and final sign-off rest with people.

responsibilities_block: Assess learning progress and identify knowledge gaps and causes of mistakes.
Develop phased plans and objectives for each lesson.
Explain difficult and important concepts and guide students through examples and variations.
Assign and grade homework and provide feedback through error logs.
Track grades and learning state and adjust the pace.
Communicate progress to parents and manage renewals.
page.work_context_block: Before class, review the student's mistakes from the previous week and choose the evening's topic. During class, explain one concept thoroughly and guide three practice problems. Between activities, note recurring errors. After class, send feedback to the group and assign daily practice. On weekends, conduct a stage assessment and chart progress, with workbooks from different grade levels spread across the desk.
